card.name: Pieces of foreign-language names and scripts
card.fires_on: Partway through non-English words in reference lists or script quotes, such as split Lao characters, Slovene, Latvian or German names. It fires on the broken-off piece, not on a whole English word.

modes.label: Lao script bytes
modes.description: Fires on a broken-off byte piece inside Lao script text.

modes.label: Foreign names in citations
modes.description: Fires on a mid-word piece of a Slovene, German or Malay title or publisher name.

modes.label: Foreign word pieces
modes.description: Fires on a piece inside a foreign-language word in a linguistic or reference passage.

card.writes: The promoted tokens are Polish word pieces, which suggests it nudges the model toward Polish-like word continuations.
card.plain: It lights up when a word from another language or script is cut into pieces, mostly in reference lists and quoted foreign text.
